name: rpc_synth_v2_225

layout.basket_patterns: sampled from design val images of the same level (n objects, units per SKU)

scale.fit: cach 1: per SKU and camera, median Val-A bbox area of the objects that look most like that camera / median rotated bbox area of its cutouts (>= 10 look-alikes, else the median ratio of the shape group)
scale.standing_fit: standing pose (camera 2 of upright SKUs): cutout long side = median val short side

notes: object_gain = p25..p75 of val/cutout luminance ratio per camera (measured 21/10 on design val); center stats measured on design val; jpeg quality matches val2019 (~75); pilot round 1 (21/10): synth/val median bbox area 0.91 -> scale calibration 1/sqrt(0.91)=1.048; bbox covered p50 below val -> center_std x0.9; layout v2 (o15, 21/10): pixel occlusion measured with SAM box masks on 450 val images (notch share 2.8/4.5/5.2%) -> each object >= 90% visible, compact baskets, 15% of scenes (and baskets too full to lie apart) allow 75%; release v1 (scatter, min_visible 0.7) hid 4x more
